headlines.title: White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt to step down
headlines.description: Leavitt, 28, is the youngest person to serve in the role. She will leave the Trump administration at the end of the month.

headlines.title: White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt to Step Down
headlines.description: President Donald Trump is announcing Karoline Leavitt will be departing as White House Press Secretary at the end of August after more than a year and half on the job. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Attempted Reagan assassin’s message to Jodie Foster
headlines.description: John Hinckley, Jr. spoke about Jodie Foster in a bizarre new podcast interview. He shot President Reagan in a twisted attempt to impress the actress. NBC News’ Anne Thompson reports.

headlines.title: Indiana Fever head coach says critics trying to 'hijack' the WNBA can 'go to hell'
headlines.description: Indiana Fever head coach Stephanie White says the critics who are trying to "hijack" the WNBA can "go to hell." It comes after Fever guard Sophie Cunningham spoke against transgender women and girl athletes in an ESPN interview, and Cunningham being on the receiving end of a flagrant foul. NBC News' Sam Brock reports.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: 3 takeaways from David Crowley’s comeback: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: Welcome to From the Politics Desk, a daily newsletter that brings you the NBC News Politics team’s latest reporting and analysis from the White House, Capitol Hill and the campaign trail.

headlines.title: Extremism expert charged in case on Southern Poverty Law Center informants
headlines.description: “A free and fair society does not use the justice system to silence its political opponents,” Heidi Beirich’s attorney said in a statement.

headlines.title: John Hinckley Jr., who shot Ronald Reagan to impress Jodie Foster, says he wishes her well
headlines.description: Hinckley shot President Ronald Reagan as he was leaving the Washington Hilton in 1981.

headlines.title: David Crowley upsets democratic socialist Francesca Hong in Wisconsin governor primary
headlines.description: NBC News projects that Crowley, the Milwaukee County executive backed by Gov. Tony Evers, narrowly defeated Hong, a democratic socialist state lawmaker, in the key battleground state.

headlines.title: Minnesota GOP picks Lisa Demuth over Trump-backed Mike Lindell for governor against Democrat Amy Klobuchar
headlines.description: Demuth, the state House speaker, defeated Trump-endorsed Lindell for the Republican nomination, NBC News projects, while Klobuchar romped in her primary.

headlines.title: Progressive Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan wins Minnesota Democratic Senate primary
headlines.description: Flanagan defeated Rep. Angie Craig, NBC News projects, in yet another nominating contest that exposed Democratic ideological divides.

headlines.title: Trump says security threat spurred secret plane swap in Turkey
headlines.description: The president spoke for the first time about a previously undisclosed flight after the NATO summit in July.
